name: pdf-to-text
description: Extract text from PDFs, either from a URL or base64-encoded PDF data.

pdf_url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the PDF to download and extract text from.

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes. Use this when you already have the PDF contents.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to process, starting from page 1.

strip_whitespace.description: If true, collapse excessive whitespace/newlines in extracted text.

user_agent.description: Optional User-Agent header when fetching pdf_url. Overrides default and any environment value.

split_by.description: How to split the extracted text. 'page' returns per-page text; 'chunk' additionally returns contiguous text chunks.

inputs.description: Exactly one of pdf_url or pdf_base64 must be provided. This is enforced at runtime.

raw_text.description: All page texts concatenated together (typically separated by newlines).

chunks.description: Optional text chunks when split_by='chunk'. Omitted when split_by='page'.

start_page.description: 1-based index of the first page that contributed text to this chunk.

end_page.description: 1-based index of the last page that contributed text to this chunk.

page_count.description: Total number of pages in the PDF (may be greater than pages.length if truncated by max_pages).

truncated.description: True if extraction stopped early due to max_pages.

source.description: Source type used for extraction, e.g. 'url' or 'base64'.

url.description: The URL used to fetch the PDF, if any.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. INPUT_INVALID, FETCH_FAILED, PARSE_FAILED).

details.description: Optional structured context (e.g. HTTP status, URL, page index).
